FUNCTION validate_collection_team_scope CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION validate_collection_team_scope() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ DECLARE collection_scope UUID; member_scope UUID; BEGIN SELECT organization_id INTO collection_scope FROM collection WHERE id=NEW.collection_id; SELECT organization_id INTO member_scope FROM team_member WHERE id=NEW.team_member_id; IF collection_scope IS DISTINCT FROM member_scope THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Collection team must belong to the collection organization' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$
